title: Identifying and installing usage specs for your entire project
description:
🤖 Is your AI agent struggling to understand the open-source libraries in your project? For an agent to be effective, it needs the right context about the tools you're using.

In this quick tutorial, we demonstrate how to automatically identify and install usage specifications for every direct dependency in your project. Watch as we use an agent to:

- Discover all direct dependencies in a project.
- Search the Tessl Spec Registry using the MCP search tool.
- Match and install the correct version of each usage spec into the local file system.

This process ensures your AI has the deep knowledge and context required to build effectively with your entire tech stack. By providing these usage specs, you empower your agent to code efficiently with all your project dependencies.
